rollback.title: Rollback SQL
rollback.isRollbackOrderDescription: Executes inverse SQL generated from captured evidence after verifying live row/schema preconditions.
rollback.revealHint: Deterministically derived from captured before/after images or schema diffs; watermarked & audited.
rollback.draftCreatedToast: Rollback draft opened — run AI precheck and submit
rollback.rolledBackAlertDescription: Reverted via a completed Rollback CR.

statusDescription.not_requested: Rollback capture was disabled on submission.
statusDescription.pending: Inverse SQL will be captured automatically upon execution.
statusDescription.available: Verified rollback evidence captured; inspect SQL or spin up a Rollback CR.
statusDescription.unsupported: Contains statements without deterministic inverse SQL.
statusDescription.evidence_incomplete: Rollback capture incomplete; auto-generation blocked for safety.
statusDescription.conflicted: Live DB rows/schema drifted since execution; auto-rollback blocked.
statusDescription.rollback_in_progress: A Rollback CR is currently in flight.
statusDescription.rollback_failed: Prior rollback attempt failed; inspect state before creating a new Rollback CR.

execution.actionNote: Only assigned executors can run or schedule this stage; approval never auto-runs SQL.
execution.semanticsNote: DML: single transaction per stage (rolls back all statements on error). DDL: auto-commit sequentially (failure keeps prior DDLs and marks Partial Failed).
execution.dmlSemanticsNote: DML: atomic stage transaction (rolls back on any error).
execution.confirmDescription: Runs the exact signed-off SQL rev; executors cannot alter statements, targets, or options.
execution.ddlWarningDescription: DDL runs statement-by-statement without rollback: on error, trailing statements abort, applied DDLs remain, CR stops as Partial Failed, and cannot be retried in place.
execution.scheduleCreated: Scheduled for {{time}} (missed windows never auto-catch up).
execution.preflightPending: Preflight running: verifying SQL hash & approval snapshot…
execution.preflightHashOk: Preflight OK: SQL hash matches approved snapshot.
execution.cancelDescription: Best-effort DB cancel: DML rolls back stage txn; DDL halts remaining statements; unconfirmed kills route to Outcome Unknown verification.
execution.verifyDescription: DB connection dropped or timed out post-send: result is unconfirmed. Attach DB evidence to record final verdict; this attempt cannot be re-run.
execution.verifyWaitingDescription: Only assigned executors for this stage may verify live DB state (Admins cannot override).
execution.evidencePlaceholder: e.g., SELECT COUNT(*), SHOW SLAVE STATUS, or incident link
execution.copyDescription: Failed attempts cannot retry in place — clone SQL to a new draft and re-run precheck & approvals.
execution.copyDialogDescription: Clones SQL, title, and workflow only; approvals and execution history stay clean.
execution.schedulePrefilled: Prefilled from author's preferred window; adjust if needed.
execution.scheduledNote: Queued for {{time}} (one-shot; skipped if window missed).
execution.scheduledCancelNote: Any assigned executor can cancel to return this CR to Ready to Run (schedules survive server restarts).
execution.cancelScheduleDescription: Returns this CR to Ready to Run; nothing will auto-execute at the scheduled time.
execution.waitNote: Approved and waiting on assigned executors ({{names}}).
execution.scheduleLeadHint: Must be at least 5m in the future.
execution.oscOverridesHint: Applies to MySQL ALTER TABLE OSC only; blank inputs inherit global defaults.
execution.ddlModeGhOstHint: Throttled chunk copy with replication lag & load guards — safest for table-rebuilding MySQL ALTERs.
execution.ddlModeOnlineDdlHint: Uses InnoDB Online DDL directly — best for instant metadata-only columns or secondary indexes.

failureReasons.LEDGER_INCONSISTENT: Attempt ledger mismatch; manual verification required

failureReasons.undefined_table: Table or view does not exist

reasoning.sql_optimize:
1. Scope Check: Confirmed request is SQL tuning & index analysis (sql_optimize).
2. PII Scrubbing: Tokenized identifiers and literals with zero raw table-data egress.
3. Analysis: Reviewed authorized schema, index metadata, and EXPLAIN plan signals.
reasoning.sql_generate:
1. Scope Check: Confirmed request is governed single-statement SQL authoring (sql_generate).
2. Schema Grounding: Drafted SQL against scrubbed catalog metadata for the target schema.
3. AST Verification: Validated single-statement AST, blocked dangerous patterns, and restored identifiers.
reasoning.platform_help:
1. Scope Check: Confirmed request is YearningX workflow or troubleshooting help (platform_help).
2. Doc Retrieval: Matched role-scoped v4.0.0 platform guides.
3. Response: Synthesized step-by-step guidance with direct doc links.
